decisions.reason: Core glass-silicon wafer with through contacts fits the firm's precision substrate and packaging direction and builds on established capabilities.
Carrier wafers support the stated focus on reusable carriers, though smaller-diameter handling may be less strategic than larger formats.
Copper interposer glass wafer is a flagship product aligned with advanced packaging and multifunctional wafers.
Off-the-shelf glass and quartz wafer brand is a strategic flagship close to the firm's core offer and likely a growth area.
Glass-based circuit boards are distant from the established core and show no ongoing promotion, making them likely to be discontinued to refocus resources.
